description: Frontend access to the attachment endpoints, added to the single API module every request already goes through, so the bearer token and the unauthorised-response handling apply here too. Upload needs multipart rather than the JSON default, and download needs a binary response — both are reasons to extend the shared client rather than reach for a direct call at the component.
expectedBehavior: List, upload, download and delete are exposed as functions on the shared API module
Upload sends multipart and reports progress well enough for a large file to show movement
No component calls the network directly
Field names match the API exactly — no renaming across the wire
verificationSteps: Grep the frontend source for direct network calls outside the shared API module and confirm there are none
